description: Send keystrokes to a tmux target, optionally appending Enter.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

keys.description: The text/keys to send. Supports <SPACE>/<ENTER>/<TAB>/<ESC>. Empty + enter=true sends Enter.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

name: tmux_send_keys
title: Send keys to pane
